mixerConfigurations.name: High-Capacity Industrial Dual-Speed Spiral Mixer (200 kg Dough / 125 kg Flour, 18.5 kW Dual Motor, Heavy Helical Gear Drive)
mixerConfigurations.description: High-throughput industrial commercial bakery spiral mixer engineered for wholesale bread and bagel lines. Utilizes dual independent motors with cast iron gearbox and hardened helical gearing to transfer up to 2,850 Nm of torque into heavy dough masses.

mixerConfigurations.name: Mid-Scale Wholesale Bakery Spiral Mixer (120 kg Dough / 75 kg Flour, 9.2 kW Inverter Motor, Poly-V Belt + Planetary Reduction)
mixerConfigurations.description: Mid-sized commercial bakery workhorse equipped with variable frequency drive (VFD) electronic acceleration ramps and multi-ribbed poly-V serpentine belts to dampen mechanical shock loads during hydration mixing.

mixerConfigurations.name: Heavy-Duty Artisan Pizzeria & Bagel Fixed-Bowl Spiral Mixer (60 kg Dough / 40 kg Flour, 5.5 kW Dual-Speed, Dual V-Belt Drive)
mixerConfigurations.description: Specialized high-torque spiral mixer designed for low-hydration bagel, pretzel, and Neapolitan pizza doughs. Dual V-belts drive the main spiral hook while an auxiliary chain drives the stainless steel bowl rim.

mixerConfigurations.name: Removable-Bowl Heavy Industrial Spiral Mixer System (250 kg Dough / 160 kg Flour, 26 kW Hydraulic Clamp & Dual Drive)
mixerConfigurations.description: Heavy automated continuous production system with motorized hydraulic bowl docking, automatic head tilting, and dual planetary gearboxes for round-the-clock commercial bakery mixing cycles.

mixerConfigurations.name: Legacy 14-Year Bakery Spiral Mixer (Loose V-Belts, Non-Food-Grade Gearbox, Vibrating Microswitch Bracket)
mixerConfigurations.description: Aging commercial installation with worn belt sheaves, severe gear backlash, deteriorated shaft seals, and vibrating safety guard interlock switch that experiences chronic false contact bounce.

doughTypes.name: Low-Hydration Stiff Bagel & Pretzel Dough (48–52% Hydration, 14.5% High-Gluten Flour)
doughTypes.description: Extremely stiff dough requiring tremendous mechanical work input. High gluten elasticity creates severe radial and axial reaction forces against the spiral tool and drive gears.

doughTypes.name: Traditional Pizza & Focaccia Dough (60–64% Hydration, 12.5% Strong Flour)
doughTypes.description: Standard medium-hydration fermented dough. Balance between gluten tensile development and extensibility requires careful temperature control to avoid premature gas release.

doughTypes.name: Commercial White Sandwich Bread Dough (65–68% Hydration, Standard Bakers Flour)
doughTypes.description: High-speed commercial pan bread formulation. Rapid mechanical dough development (Chorleywood-style or dual-speed spiral) generates quick gluten film with moderate friction.

doughTypes.name: High-Hydration Artisan Sourdough / Ciabatta (76–82% Hydration, Open Crumb)
doughTypes.description: Very wet, slack dough with low shear resistance initially. Requires extended spiral rotation at speed 2 to incorporate water into protein networks without mechanical over-shearing.

doughTypes.name: Dense Whole Grain & 60% Rye Bread Dough (58–62% Hydration, High Pentosans/Fiber)
doughTypes.description: High-viscosity mucilaginous rye dough rich in arabinoxylans. Lacks gluten matrix but exerts high viscous drag on the spiral arm, causing rapid motor current rise and gear tooth friction.

safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.name: ISO 13849-1 Cat 4 / PL-e Dual Monitored RFID Safety Interlock with Guard Locking & Vibration Isolation
safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.interlockType: Coded RFID Transponder + Mechanical Guard Solenoid
safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.description: State-of-the-art bakery guarding compliant with OSHA 1910.212 and ANSI/ASB 101. Features vibration-damped bracket, RFID coded key with zero mechanical contact wear, and solenoid guard locking that prevents opening while the spiral hook is coasting to a stop.

safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.name: ANSI/ASB Standard 101 Positive-Opening Contact Microswitch with Spring Return (Standard OEM)
safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.interlockType: Direct Drive Positive Opening NC Contact
safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.description: Standard OEM mechanical interlock roller switch actuated by the stainless steel bowl guard wire rim. Direct opening force guarantees circuit break even if contacts weld, but mounting screws can loosen under 1.0+ G vibration.

safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.name: Vibration-Drifted Misaligned Microswitch with Loose Bracket (Intermittent Nuisance Trips)
safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.description: Worn or vibration-loosened microswitch bracket has shifted by 3–5 mm. Machine shuts off intermittently during high-speed dough kneading due to bowl rim vibration, prompting dangerous operator defeat.

safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.name: Bypassed / Jumpered Safety Circuit (Severe OSHA 1910.212 Willful Violation)
safetyGuardsAndInterlocks.description: Catastrophic OSHA violation. Safety guard microswitch has been electrically bypassed or wedged open. Operator can reach into rotating bowl while 210 RPM spiral hook exerts 2,000+ Nm of torque, presenting catastrophic amputation hazards.

gearboxLubricants.name: NSF H1 Synthetic Polyalphaolefin Gear Oil (ISO VG 220 Food-Grade, Flash Point 265°C)
gearboxLubricants.toxicityRisk: Zero (FDA 21 CFR § 178.3570 Incidental Food Contact Safe)
gearboxLubricants.description: Full synthetic food-grade hydrocarbon lubricant for commercial bakery gearboxes. High viscosity index prevents gear tooth welding under shock torque spikes while ensuring total food safety.

gearboxLubricants.name: NSF H1 High-Load Polyurea Synthetic Grease with PTFE (NLGI 2, Drop Point >260°C)
gearboxLubricants.toxicityRisk: Zero (FDA 21 CFR § 178.3570 Incidental Food Contact Safe)
gearboxLubricants.description: Premium food-grade grease for mixer head bearings and upper spiral hook shaft glands directly above the dough bowl. Zero oil separation prevents weeping drips into dough batches.

gearboxLubricants.name: Conventional Industrial EP2 Mineral Gear Grease (Non-Food Grade, Toxic Zinc/Lead Additives)
gearboxLubricants.toxicityRisk: Severe Chemical Contamination (Heavy Metals, PAHs, Toxic Additives)
gearboxLubricants.description: Non-food-grade mineral grease strictly prohibited in food preparation machinery under NSF/ANSI 8. Shaft seal leakage drops toxic chemical additives directly into mixing dough.

gearboxLubricants.name: Thermally Oxidized & Acidic Gearbox Sludge (TAN > 3.5 mg KOH/g, Suspended Metal Shavings)
gearboxLubricants.toxicityRisk: Severe Physical & Chemical Hazard (Abrasive Iron Particles & Acidic Varnish)
gearboxLubricants.description: Old, neglected gear lubricant full of microscopic metal wear particles from gear tooth spalling. Accelerated friction generates severe localized heat, breaking down shaft seals.
